name: At the Woods Guest House Tsitsikamma Storms River
description_short: Guest house with hearty breakfasts and warm hospitality in the heart of Storms River village.
description_long:
At the Woods Guest House offers more than just accommodation — their breakfast spread has become a highlight for visitors exploring Tsitsikamma. Set in the quiet village of Storms River, this welcoming establishment serves generous morning meals that fuel adventure seekers heading to the nearby national park and forest trails.

The relaxed atmosphere and attentive service create a home-away-from-home feel that guests consistently praise. Whether you're planning a day at the Storms River Mouth or exploring the canopy tours, you'll start with a proper breakfast in comfortable surroundings. The guest house's central location on Formosa Street makes it easy to access local restaurants and activity operators on foot.

This is the kind of place where you'll linger over coffee, swap stories with fellow travellers, and get honest local tips about what to see and do in the area.
